definitions.gloss: hemming; taking up the hem (of trousers or a skirt)
definitions.explanation: Shortening trousers, jeans, or a skirt by turning up and sewing the hem to fit the wearer. Clothing shops in Japan commonly offer it when you buy trousers.

examples.japanese: ⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾上|すそあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To hem a pair of trousers.

examples.japanese: {裾上|すそあ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can you hem them for free?

examples.japanese: ⟦ジーンズ→ジーンズ：00123_jiinzu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}ったら→買う：00489_kau⟧、{裾上|すそあ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧ほど⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When I bought jeans, they told me to wait about thirty minutes until the hemming was done.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧ (hem) + {上|あ}げ (raising).

USAGE:
In a shop, staff measure the length with pins and ask {裾上|すそあ}げ⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧; it is often free with the purchase, or done on the spot or within a day or two.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裾上|すそあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to hem / ask for hemming
- {裾上|すそあ}げ⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧: iron-on hemming tape
- {裾上|すそあ}げ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free hemming
